verdict: Yes, with quality you can prove. Beast Life from Kanpur pitched affordable protein supplements on Shark Tank India Season 4, but didn't get a deal. Protein demand is huge in smaller cities, but buyers fear fakes, so lab tests matter.
angle: Gym culture has spread to tier-2 and tier-3 cities, where buyers want affordable whey. Fake and under-dosed products are common. Published lab reports and fair prices win loyalty.
